query: INSERT INTO userCompanyAccess (userId, companyId, role, createdAt, updatedAt) SELECT u.id, 2, 'manager', NOW(), NOW() FROM users u WHERE u.email LIKE '%eromanlec%' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM userCompanyAccess WHERE userId = u.id AND companyId = 2)
